transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you into the clinic today?

Hi. Well, I came in today because I've been dealing with something unsettling at work. I'm a secondary school teacher, and lately... I just can’t shake the feeling that certain staff emails and the morning announcements are actually coded messages about me. My colleagues have gently shown me that those emails were sent out to everyone, but I still just can't stop feeling like they have a hidden meaning directed at me.
How long have you been feeling like these announcements and emails contain messages meant for you?

Well, I'd say it's been going on for about four months now. That's when I first started worrying about the coded messages. And... I suppose it's also about how long I've been dealing with this other thing. There is a voice I hear sometimes, and I actually find myself answering it out loud. So, both the worries about the messages and the voice have been happening for roughly four months.
During these past four months, have you been experiencing a persistently low or depressed mood?

No, not really. I mean... I've definitely been stressed and distracted by everything going on, but I wouldn't say my mood has been low or depressed. I don't feel sad, just... preoccupied with it all, I suppose.
Have you had any periods where you felt unusually energized, hyperactive, or on top of the world?

No, I haven't had anything like that. I mean, I definitely haven't felt on top of the world lately. My energy levels are just... pretty normal, I think. Maybe a little drained from all the stress at work, but I definitely haven't been hyperactive or unusually energized.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical or neurological conditions, or had any recent physical illnesses or head injuries?

No, nothing like that. I haven't had any head injuries or... neurological conditions. I'm generally pretty healthy, actually. I haven't been sick lately either, so no, I don't have any other medical issues.
Have you used any recreational drugs or substances recently?
No, I haven't. I don't use any drugs or... substances like that. I never really have, to be honest.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient reports clear auditory hallucinations (hearing a voice and conversing with it) along with delusions of reference (believing general emails and morning announcements contain hidden, coded messages specifically directed at them). These symptoms have persisted for approximately four months, well exceeding the 1-month duration requirement for schizophrenia under ICD-10. Affective disorders (depression, mania) and secondary causes (substance use, neurological/general medical conditions) were systematically excluded.
